mbti_pole_low.label: High Sensory Precision (S)

mbti_pole_high.label: High Generative Prior (N)
mbti_pole_high.mechanism: Weights top-down abstract generative models, cross-domain patterns & possibilities

aspects.name: Abstract Systemizing (Intellect)
aspects.substrate: Dorsolateral PFC working-memory abstraction & causal modeling

aspects.name: Perceptual & Aesthetic Depth
aspects.substrate: Default Mode Network (DMN) semantic spreading & perceptual absorption

domains.name: Attractor Depth vs. Exploration Temperature
domains.neural_substrate: Striatal D1/D2 action gating & dlPFC goal maintenance vs. high-temperature state-space foraging

mbti_pole_low.label: High Exploration Temp (P)
mbti_pole_low.mechanism: Maintains shallow attractor basins for rapid pivoting, novelty foraging & open options

mbti_pole_high.label: Deep Attractor Locking (J)
mbti_pole_high.mechanism: Deepens goal-state attractors to minimize temporal entropy and close open loops

aspects.name: Goal-Locked Drive (Industriousness)
aspects.substrate: Striatal-prefrontal effort mobilization (highly sensitive to Salience vs. Routine gating)

aspects.name: Entropy Suppression (Orderliness)
aspects.substrate: Orbitofrontal/basal ganglia regularity & environmental structure preference

domains.name: External Foraging vs. Internal Simulation
domains.neural_substrate: Mesolimbic phasic/tonic Dopamine (VTA -> Nucleus Accumbens) reward-prediction-error gain

mbti_pole_low.label: Internal World Simulation (I)
mbti_pole_low.mechanism: Optimizes cortical arousal via low-noise internal simulation and selective 1-on-1 depth

mbti_pole_high.label: External Reward Foraging (E)
mbti_pole_high.mechanism: Up-regulates dopaminergic gain through high-bandwidth external social & environmental foraging

aspects.name: Affiliative Reward Gain (Enthusiasm)
aspects.substrate: Ventral striatal + endogenous opioid social warmth & positive affect resonance

aspects.name: Agency & Social Impact (Assertiveness)
aspects.substrate: Dopaminergic incentive salience & hippocampal Power-axis navigation

domains.name: Allostatic Coupling vs. Decoupled Logic
domains.neural_substrate: Anterior Insula / ACC / Oxytocin allostatic coupling vs. decoupled algorithmic policy optimization

mbti_pole_low.label: Decoupled Systemic Logic (T)
mbti_pole_low.mechanism: Decouples policy evaluation from interpersonal affect to optimize objective truth & game-theoretic fairness

mbti_pole_high.label: Allostatic Social Coupling (F)
mbti_pole_high.mechanism: Couples other agents' homeostatic/emotional prediction errors directly into one's own objective function

aspects.name: Normative Friction Suppression (Politeness)
aspects.substrate: Ventromedial PFC inhibition of antagonistic social impulses

domains.name: Threat & Uncertainty Error Gain
domains.neural_substrate: Serotonergic dorsal raphe tone + Amygdala-Habenula-Insula negative prediction-error gain

mbti_pole_low.label: Damped Error Gain (-A)
mbti_pole_low.mechanism: High serotonergic buffer; absorbs negative prediction errors without global state destabilization

mbti_pole_high.label: High Vigilance Gain (-T)
mbti_pole_high.mechanism: High precision on negative prediction errors, threat forecasting & error-corrective vigilance

aspects.name: Uncertainty Vigilance (Withdrawal)
aspects.substrate: Hippocampal-septal behavioral inhibition system (BIS) & anticipatory caution

aspects.name: Affective State Gain (Volatility)
aspects.substrate: Amygdala-periaqueductal active defense reactivity to blocked goals

masks_schema.description: Neurodevelopmental Modulatory Masks (B_wiring) with Blind Epistemic Double-Dissociation Signatures and calm, non-clinical user translations.

masks.name: Interest-Based Nervous System (Dopamine-Foraging / Salience-Gated)
masks.calm_summary: Your focus is powered by meaning, novelty, and genuine interest rather than routine obligation. Everyday checklists can feel surprisingly heavy, yet when a question or project truly captures your heart, your depth of focus is extraordinary.
masks.calm_reframe: Most personality tests mistake a dislike of routine errands for 'low discipline.' Once we separate routine chores from curiosity-driven work, your true follow-through is strong and deeply devoted.
masks.neural_mechanism: Lower tonic prefrontal/striatal dopamine baseline paired with high-amplitude phasic bursts under novelty, urgency, or deep intrinsic interest. Action gating is salience-coupled rather than routine-coupled.
masks.diagnostic_note: Standard tests misread low routine chore completion (-22% C offset) as 'low conscientiousness.' De-confounding reveals high Salience-Locked Hyperfocus (+34% drive on high-interest problems).

masks.name: Monotropic / High-Sensory-Precision (Deep-Tunnel Systemizer)
masks.calm_summary: You experience the world in high definition. Busy, overlapping rooms drain your energy quickly—not because you don't care about people, but because your mind naturally tunes in deeply to one conversation or idea at a time.
masks.calm_reframe: Traditional tests often confuse crowd fatigue with being 'distant.' In quiet, one-on-one spaces where you don't have to filter out background noise, your warmth and loyalty shine clearly.
masks.neural_mechanism: Elevated bottom-up thalamocortical sensory precision (pi_sensory) and deep, narrow attention tunnels (Monotropism). High-entropy social environments trigger sensory saturation rather than social apathy.
masks.diagnostic_note: Standard tests misclassify sensory crowd-fatigue (-24% E) and direct communication (-12% A) as 'aloofness.' Masking isolates genuine 1-on-1 allostatic loyalty (+28% de-confounded social capacity).

masks.name: Dual-Attractor Paradox (Novelty Foraging × Sensory Sanctuary)
masks.calm_summary: You hold a rare, creative balance inside you: one part of your mind craves fresh horizons, new ideas, and spontaneity, while another part needs a quiet, predictable sanctuary to feel grounded.
masks.calm_reframe: On ordinary personality tests, your love of novelty and your need for calm cancel each other out into a blurry middle score. Seeing both sides together honors how you actually move through the world.
masks.neural_mechanism: Simultaneous prefrontal novelty foraging (dopamine-salience gating) and high bottom-up sensory precision requiring environmental predictability.
masks.diagnostic_note: Competing needs for novelty and order cancel out on linear tests. This mask unmasks bimodal high-entropy intellectual exploration paired with low-noise sensory protection.

masks.name: High-Gain Perceptive & Allostatic Sensor (Deep Perceptual Resolution)
masks.calm_summary: You notice subtle shifts in tone, atmosphere, music, and emotion that others walk right past. Because you take in so much nuance, you feel both beauty and tension more vividly than most.
masks.calm_reframe: Most tests lump deep perceptiveness into 'worry' or 'stress.' Separating your natural attentiveness from stress shows a remarkably steady, perceptive core.
masks.neural_mechanism: Amplified insula and mirror-network gain on subtle aesthetic, emotional, and interpersonal micro-signals.
masks.diagnostic_note: Standard Big Five tests dump high perceptual & empathic resolution straight into 'High Neuroticism' (+18% N offset). Masking separates signal sensitivity from emotional dysregulation.

masks.name: Canonical Allistic Baseline (Steady-Current Rhythm)
masks.calm_summary: Your energy flows with a natural, even cadence across both everyday routines and shared social spaces. You don't have to fight steep internal friction just to switch between tasks or environments.
masks.calm_reframe: Because your baseline pace translates directly into everyday habits, your portrait reflects your preferences with very little hidden friction.
masks.neural_mechanism: Standard tonic/phasic striatal dopamine gating with linear routine-to-action coupling and typical thalamocortical sensory attenuation.
masks.diagnostic_note: Standard normative comparison with minimal neurodevelopmental mask offset.

item_bank_schema.description: 15-Item Epistemic Blind-Inference & Shadow Calibration Bank (12 Calibrated Anchors + 3 Disarming Sneaky Behavioral Micro-Questions). Written in calm, everyday human language for the user while encoding Double-Dissociation Context Splits, Psychophysical Reference Anchors, Compensatory Masking Cost, Differential Epoch State probes, and Empirical Shadow-Calibration Candidates for the Science Engine.

items.text: When I’m learning something new, I naturally look for the deeper pattern of how it all fits together before worrying about the small details.
A small shift in the light in a room, a piece of music, or someone’s tone of voice can stay with me for a long time.
Simple everyday errands can sit on my list for days, yet when a question or project truly fascinates me, hours pass like minutes.
My mind feels noticeably calmer when my space is tidy and I know what the next few days look like.
When two conversations are happening at the same table, both voices reach me at almost the same volume—I feel much more at ease talking one-on-one.
If a group of friends or coworkers is unsure what to do next, I feel comfortable gently stepping in to guide the plan.
In a disagreement with someone I care about, making sure we both feel heard matters more to me than winning the point.
I appreciate when people say exactly what they mean, rather than wrapping the truth in polite hints.
Even when things are going well, part of my mind quietly thinks ahead to what might need protecting.
When plans change suddenly, I usually find my footing quickly without feeling thrown off for long.
People around me see me as steady and on top of things, though they rarely see how much quiet effort it takes me behind the scenes.
Compared to times in my life when I’ve felt most rested and at ease, these past couple of weeks have felt heavier or more tiring.
Having 20+ open browser tabs or saved links feels more like a cozy library of possibilities than clutter I need to clear right away.
items.scientific_hypothesis: Disarming ecological behavioral proxy for exploratory novelty foraging vs. linear closure (Anchor C r = -0.61, Salience-Split r = +0.64) that bypasses self-evaluative shame around 'messiness'.

items.text: When sending a short text like 'Sounds good', I often add an exclamation point, emoji, or 'haha' just so a plain period doesn't accidentally read as cold.
items.scientific_hypothesis: Disarming digital pragmatics proxy for interpersonal allostatic cushioning and affiliative tone regulation (Anchor A r = +0.58, Compensatory Masking r = +0.44).

items.text: When a social plan I genuinely wanted to go to gets canceled at the last minute, my very first physical reaction is a quiet wave of relief.
items.scientific_hypothesis: Decouples affiliative care ('genuinely wanted to go') from autonomic transition & sensory saturation cost (Anchor E r = -0.63, Acoustic Stream Split r = +0.59).

cognitive_telemetry_priors.description: Scientific priors, psychophysical reference norms, and Bayesian de-confounding rules for Aura's 3 Behavioral Micro-Game Telemetry Probes (Pulse Reaction, Constellation Memory, and Mind's Eye Imagery Spectrum).

pulse_reaction.title: Pulse Reaction (Attentional Cadence & Dopamine Gating)
pulse_reaction.scientific_construct: Drift-Diffusion Decision Threshold & Intra-Individual Reaction-Time Variability (RT IIV)

median_rt_ms.description: Median simple visuomotor reaction time across trials (ms). Normative adult baseline ~290ms.

rt_cv_pct.description: Intra-individual reaction-time coefficient of variation (SD / Mean * 100). Values >22% indicate phasic attentional fluctuation and spark-driven dopaminergic policy gating.

false_starts.description: Anticipatory motor responses prior to stimulus onset, reflecting high exploratory readiness / lowered decision boundary during unstimulating wait intervals.

steady_measured.label: Steady & Measured Cadence
steady_measured.calm_note: Your attention locks in with an even, metronomic rhythm—giving you steady pacing across both quiet and fast-moving moments.

quick_spark.label: Quick-Spark & Dynamic Cadence
quick_spark.calm_note: Your attention moves in quick, high-energy bursts—anticipating what comes next and surging fastest when a moment feels alive and urgent.

deep_deliberate.label: Deliberate & High-Precision Cadence
deep_deliberate.calm_note: Your mind takes a beat to verify the signal before acting, trading rushed reflexes for calm, unhurried accuracy.

constellation_memory.title: Constellation Memory (Visuospatial Working Memory & Chunking)
constellation_memory.scientific_construct: Short-Term Synaptic Chunk Compression & Relational Schema Encoding

accuracy_pct.description: Percentage of spatial constellation nodes accurately reconstructed from working memory (0..100).

mean_chunk_ms.description: Mean inter-tap transition latency (ms) during pattern reconstruction. High accuracy paired with fast inter-tap chunking boosts the abstract pattern synthesis (Intellect / Systemizing) prior.

holistic_constellation.label: Holistic Constellation Memory
holistic_constellation.calm_note: Instead of memorizing isolated dots one by one, your mind naturally compresses the whole geometry into a single connected shape.

methodical_architect.label: Careful Structural Memory
methodical_architect.calm_note: You rebuild complex patterns step by step with deliberate care, making sure each piece fits before placing the next.

impressionistic_forager.label: Big-Picture Impression Memory
impressionistic_forager.calm_note: Your mind captures the overall gesture and movement of a pattern rather than holding onto rigid grid coordinates.

minds_eye.title: Mind's Eye (Cortical Imagery Vividness & Inner Modality)
minds_eye.scientific_construct: Top-Down V1 Sensory Projection vs. Non-Retinotopic Conceptual/Spatial Representation

imagery_vividness.description: Subjective and probed visual imagery vividness on a 0..100 scale, spanning Aphantasia (<=18) to Hyperphantasia (>=81).

inner_modality.description: Primary representational format of spontaneous inner thought.

vividness_spectrum.calm_note: Your mind works like a quiet architect: instead of projecting literal pictures behind your eyes, you hold rich, wordless models of how ideas, spaces, and feelings fit together. Standard personality tests often mistake 'not seeing mental pictures' for having less imagination—so we gently corrected your Curiosity & Imagination score (+{boost_pct}%) to honor your true conceptual depth.

You think primarily through meaning, intuition, and light gestural outlines rather than heavy visual detail—letting your mind move quickly to the heart of an idea without getting bogged down in surface rendering.
You can readily call up clear scenes, colors, and memories in your mind's eye, blending visual imagery smoothly with everyday thought.
Your inner world renders in cinema-grade light, texture, and motion—allowing you to replay memories and simulate future possibilities almost as vividly as seeing them in person.

wordless_concept.description: Representing ideas directly as abstract relational structures, spatial intuition, and pure meaning prior to words or images.

inner_voice.description: Representing thoughts through an articulate internal narrative, cadence, dialogue, and verbal resonance.

visual_cinema.description: Representing thoughts as dynamic visual scenes, spatial environments, and sensory simulations.

aphantasia_deconfounder.mechanism: When imagery_vividness <= 25, standard aesthetic/visual Openness items under-estimate the user's true imaginative capacity by 12%–18% because they imagine via wordless conceptual/spatial models rather than V1 visual pictures.
